name: nuxt
title: Nuxt
description: Nuxt app scaffolded by nuxi init, wired into the mx stack with Traefik routing and dev/prod Docker builds
features: App scaffolded by `nuxi init` itself: the framework owns package.json and the app tree
Dependency-free /api/health endpoint (works on a fresh scaffold)
Nitro server (node-server output) in the production stage
Traefik reverse proxy routing on a .localhost domain

init_cmd.default: CI=true NUXI_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npx nuxi@latest init {{SERVICE_NAME}} --template minimal --no-install --no-gitInit --packageManager npm
init_cmd.description: Command to scaffold the Nuxt app (runs from ./apps; must be non-interactive and must create {{SERVICE_NAME}}/)

force_init.description: Re-run init_cmd by deleting apps/{{SERVICE_NAME}} first (DANGEROUS)

notes: `nuxi init` owns the app: package.json, nuxt.config.ts, tsconfig.json, app/app.vue and the starter tree are the scaffolder's, not this recipe's (bd:mech-crate-whj, the bd:mech-crate-874 call)
This recipe installs infra (compose, Dockerfiles, env) plus one app file: a dependency-free server/api/health.get.ts
Styling, modules and rendering mode are the app's call: add them to the scaffolded nuxt.config.ts (for example `npx nuxi module add tailwindcss`)
No lockfile ships: the Docker builds run `npm ci` when apps/<name>/package-lock.json exists and `npm install` otherwise
Re-scaffold an app from scratch with `mx add <name> --recipe nuxt --opt force_init=true` (deletes apps/<name> first)
